summary: Scope correction: loop gate readiness and metrics ship separately from missing-runtime recovery and identity changes

replay.detail: No replay or projection rebuild change. This corrects the broader branch-only scope described in loop-gate-on-demand.json before upstream publication; the effective PR contains only launch admission and telemetry.

schema.detail: No database or claim-registry field changes in this PR.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or retention transition.

compatibility.detail: Round gate launch now requires unclaimed ready work at admission and guarded spawn. Durable agent identities, assignments, client/protocol/provider contracts and launch records stay unchanged. OpenTelemetry adds idle round gate count and ready-to-verified-start latency without identity labels.

downtime.detail: No additional service restart is requested beyond replacing the daemon to activate the new behavior. Restart-to-API and restart-to-health are not measured.

manual.detail: No new manual migration or operator recovery steps. Existing running idle gates are not forcibly stopped. Missing-runtime recovery and hash-name migration are explicitly outside this PR.

recovery.detail: Missing-runtime reporting/recovery changes have been removed from this PR for a separate reproduction-first review. Existing restart, fault, manual stop and launch-producer closure behavior is unchanged. A binary rollback restores eager gate admission; it does not undo previously recorded runtime history.
